attributes.user_data: <<-EOF    #!/usr/bin/env bash    set -euxo pipefail    exec > >(tee -a /var/log/user-data.log) 2>&1    echo "=== Starting C23 Deployment on AWS EC2 ==="    # 1. System Updates & Core Packages    export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive    apt-get update -y    apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \      golang-go python3 python3-venv python3-pip \      postgresql postgresql-contrib redis-server \      git curl jq ca-certificates    # 2. Configure & Start Redis    systemctl enable redis-server    systemctl
